title: Final Period Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the period of small oscillations must be provided.

title: Stable Equilibrium Position
description: Essential Criteria: The position of stable equilibrium must be identified as x = -a.

title: Energy Conditions for Oscillation
description: Important Criteria: The condition for oscillation must correctly state v < sqrt(c/(ma)).

title: Energy Conditions for Escape
description: Important Criteria: The conditions for escaping to -infinity and +infinity must be correctly derived.

title: Second Derivative Check
description: Optional Criteria: The second derivative of potential energy should be evaluated at equilibrium positions to confirm stability.

title: Common Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for sign errors in the conditions for escape and oscillation.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all expressions for velocity are dimensionally consistent.
